title: My social media account was hacked: what you can do now
pageTitle: My social media account was hacked: what you can do now | Spamlock
description: Someone took over your Facebook, Instagram, X or WhatsApp? Steps you can take now: use the hacked-account page, set a new password and warn your friends.
answer: Use the platform’s hacked-account page to get back in, set a new password and sign out of other devices. Then warn your friends about messages you didn’t send.
stepsTitle: Steps you can take if your social media account was hacked

steps.title: Use the hacked-account page
steps.text: Pick the platform below. Its page walks you through getting your account back.

steps.title: Set a new password
steps.text: Then, in the app’s security settings, sign out of all other devices, so whoever got in is logged out. If you used the same password on other accounts, you can change it there too.

steps.title: Turn on two-step verification
steps.text: Find it in the app’s security settings. You’ll need a code or passkey as well as your password, so a stolen password alone isn’t enough to get in.

steps.title: Warn your friends
steps.text: About messages or posts you didn’t send. You can ask them to treat recent messages from your account with care.

app.title: This guide is in the Spamlock app
app.text: Mark each step as done as you go.
